subject: Anglais
title: Anglais · 1re · Discours complexe
description: Passif, discours indirect, hypothèses et expression de la nuance.

cards.front: Mets au passif : Millions of people watch the ceremony.
cards.back: The ceremony is watched by millions of people.

cards.front: Mets au passif : They built the bridge in 1890.
Rapporte : He asked, “Where do you live?”
cards.back: He asked me where I lived.

cards.front: Complète : If I ___ more time, I ___ abroad. (have / travel)
cards.back: If I had more time, I would travel abroad.

cards.front: Traduis : « J’aimerais avoir davantage confiance en moi. »
cards.back: I wish I were more confident. / I wish I had more self-confidence.

cards.front: Classe du moins au plus certain : might, must, may.
cards.back: might / may expriment une possibilité ; must exprime ici une forte déduction.

cards.front: Traduis cette déduction : « Il doit être chez lui. »
Réduis : Because she was inspired by the speech, she took action.
cards.back: Inspired by the speech, she took action.
